messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — ACME onboarding kickoff. They're migrating an existing private AMI + container bundle into AWS/GCP/Azure marketplaces and want a single timeline for certs, listing metadata, and a short trial entitlement window. I scheduled a 30m kickoff Thu 11am PT. Who can own the cert chain + publisher-side SAML?

aj: I can take owner for AWS side certs and the publisher account bootstrap. Need someone for GCP service account/KMS and Azure managed identity. Thu works for me.

kevin: Legal here — do we have the ACME DPA + indemnity flagged? If they're doing AMIs we need the export control checklist filled before publishing. I'll loop in contracts.

lucy: Platform: noted. For GCP we'll need a service account with roles: roles/compute.imageUser, roles/storage.objectViewer and access to their KMS key. For Azure we'll need the publisher tenant ID and cert thumbprint for the Service Principal. Can someone add the exact role list to the kickoff agenda?

maria: adding role lists + artifacts to agenda now. Also ACME asked for a migration helper script so their CI can push image revisions into our packaging pipeline — can we surface a small `cloud-listing-uploader` example? Ideally a single script per cloud.

aj: I have a skeleton script for AWS that uses `aws ec2 import-image` + `aws marketplace-catalog` calls. I'll attach before the meeting. Pseudo example I can share quickly:

```
# upload -> import -> create listing
./upload_to_aws.sh --ami my-ami.tar.gz --catalog-payload listing.json
```

kevin: Thanks AJ. One legal nuance — marketplace listing content requires an approved EULA text blob. Sophie, can you confirm which EULA variant ACME wants? Standard, DataSensitive, or BYOL?

sophie (ACME): We want Standard + 14-day trial. No BYOL. We'll share legal contact and the accepted EULA doc by EOD tomorrow.

maria: Great. Action items before Thu: (1) AJ: AWS uploader + sample listing payload; (2) Lucy: GCP service account role list and Azure SP steps; (3) Kevin: DPA/export checklist; (4) Sophie: confirm EULA and provide publisher admin email. I'll send calendar invite with agenda.

partner-bot: checklist created -> https://redwood.internal/marketplace/onboard/1758202020 (status: draft) :white_check_mark:

aj: also flagging a potential gap — our current packaging requires signed manifest.json with a certificate chain. If ACME uses their own CA we need the cert bundle and chain-of-trust verification steps. Recommend we include a short test harness in the uploader to validate signatures.

lucy: agree. I'll add a `verify_manifest.sh` step to the onboarding repo. Minimal example to check signature + SHA256.

maria: Perfect. If nobody objects I'll lock the agenda at EOD. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
